name: Milisius
text: Milisius is a Latinized form of Míl Espáine, the ancestor of the Milesians. Writers reached for the Latin dress when they placed the ancestor in learned prose.

attributes.attribute: Latin dress of the Milesian ancestor's name

okr.objective: Documents Milisius as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Milisius dresses the name Míl Espáine in Latin.
